name: finhub-harness
description: FinHub's harness factory: turns a domain description into an agent team, the skills they use and a surface-aware orchestrator, with an adversarially audited Authority List and mutation-tested QA. Ported from revfactory/harness v2.1.0 (Apache-2.0) and enriched from the pinned reference harnesses. Primary skill: finhub-harness (build/extend/audit a harness). Companion: finhub-harness-evolve (fold run feedback back in). The repo also ships the Master FinHub Python runtime team as its secondary capability.
